name: Cocama
catalog_quote: In KK, word stress has delimitative functions. In general, stress is fixed and occurs on the penultimate syllable of a word. Therefore, stress constitutes the basic criterion to identify word boundaries in KK.

sources.quote: 'Primary stress occurs in all words and is contrastive in its placement ... 'tata 'cooking fire' / ta'ta 'cooking fire (future)'. Primary stress occurs either on the ultimate or the penultimate syllable.' ... 'Except for the one infrequently used morpheme found to date, 'a 'in future time', primary stress would be noncontrastive, occurring on the ultima of words ending in a consonant or one syllable, otherwise on the penultima' (a'maska 'reaches' / amas'kan 'that which reaches'; ka'kɨri / kakɨ'rin).
